text:
laura: quick RFC follow-up  Im proposing an adaptive cutover scaffold for the model-router surface. Rather than a one-shot extract, we introduce a small compat-shim that can forward, mirror, normalize, or accept traffic per-tenant. Goals: reduce blast radius, enable reversible cutovers, and provide strong observability for parity checks.

henry: perf question  median extra latency?

laura: expected ~0.7-3ms on the hot path depending on auth/cache lookups. we'll measure in the infra spike.

maya: how do we detect functional regressions? hashes are noisy for some streaming outputs.

laura: plan: lightweight sampling with response-hash for signal, then semantic checks (intent/slot parity) for flagged cases. nightly deterministic regression on a canonical prompt set too.

simon: rollout controls: per-tenant token-bucket with conservative ramp. prefer linear steps early for big tenants.

laura: updated rollout sketch: start 0.25% per-tenant, add +0.25% every 30m to 5%, then geometric ramp with multiplier 1.25 every hour. monitors: response-hash-rate, intent-stability, p95 latency, error-rate. auto-pause on semantic-diff>0.2%, rollback on error>1%.

henry: KV cache mismatch will bite. compat-shim must normalize keys and emulate eviction semantics until prune.

laura: shim will provide key-translate layer with per-tenant compatibility modes behind a feature-flag. ops can toggle strict vs lax normalization.

maya: lifecycle question  when do we prune the shim? don't want long-lived adapters.

laura: prune policy: after 14 days with <0.1% semantic diffs and >95% traffic on new path, tenant marked for prune. Prune window scheduled weekly; prunes reversible for 48h.

simon: observability asks: dash tiles for percent routed to shim, semantic-diff heatmap, per-tenant ramp state, and migration-id filter. Include latency cost estimate per shard.

laura: will add dash mockups. also adding X-Migration-Id and X-Migration-Owner headers for trace filtering.

infra-bot: Created INF-501: "feature-proxy + per-tenant cutover flags for compat-shim". Owner: infra. ETA: 72h. https://tracker/redwood/INF-501

henry: tests: integration harness with KV-skew scenarios, auth-cache misses, induced latency spikes, and rollback-trigger verification. include streaming response diffs.

laura: adding a test matrix to the spike. will post RFC addendum with rollout YAML, dash mockups, test matrix, and a rollback playbook EOD. Thanks for the input.
